home.title: Sofra Cuisine
home.tagline: My Franco-Turkish, fitness and cocktail recipes

adminImport.title: Import a recipe
adminImport.intro: MVP admin flow: a source goes in, a draft comes out, then a human review decides what happens next. URL imports can now be reviewed and saved; photo import comes next.

principles.securityBody: Route kept out of public navigation, protected with a server password and an HTTP-only cookie.
principles.reviewBody: Automatic import only prepares a readable draft. Human validation stays mandatory.
principles.scopeBody: URL mode is prototyped now. Photo mode is intentionally deferred.

config.title: Configuration required
config.body: Add the following environment variable locally and on Vercel to enable the admin route.

login.title: Admin access
login.body: Enter the admin password to open the import prototype.

source.title: Import from a URL
source.body: Paste a public recipe URL. The server will try to extract title, timings, ingredients, and steps.

photo.title: Import from a photo
photo.body: The UX block is already reserved for the future photo flow, but no upload is wired in this first prototype.

saved.title: Recipe saved.
saved.body: Recipe #{id} was created in the database.

preview.reviewReminder: Review, correct, and only then consider saving.
preview.errorFallback: An unexpected error happened while analyzing the page.

review.title: Manual review before saving
review.body: Correct the draft as much as needed. Keep one ingredient per line and one step per line. Saving then creates a real recipe in the database.
review.ingredientsHelp: Keep one ingredient per line. In this MVP, each line is preserved as-is in the recipe.
review.stepsHelp: Keep one step per line. Line order becomes preparation order.
review.errorBody: the draft must at least have a title.
